title: Chop Weave: Three Tongues, One Pulse
style: afro-house meets gamelan and dub-techno, 124 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave Yoruba + Balinese + te reo Maori, deep sub bass, polyrhythmic percussion, hypnotic groove, late night warehouse energy
lyrics:
[Intro - chopped phoneme weave, pitched up, no lead vocal]
O-ya, o-ya, ka-ra-ra
be-ling, be-ling, ga-mel-an
ha-ere, ha-ere, mai-mai

[Drop 1 - 124 BPM dub-techno pulse, gamelan bells underneath]
(chopped vox only, no rap, no lead)
o-ya o-ya — ka-ra — ha-ere
be-ling — ga-mel — mai-mai

[Break - sub bass roll]
(textural pads, rim ticks, gamelan ladder)

[Drop 2 - polyrhythmic build]
three tongues — one pulse
three tongues — one pulse
(chopped phoneme stack, no lead vocal)

[Outro - dub delay tail]
ha-ere — ha-ere — mai
(fade)
